region.label: Central Huygens region only; not the whole M42

wcs.note: Header has RA/DEC TAN but no RADESYS; ICRS assumed from 2MASS reference. Ha/Hbeta/other raw maps inherit this WCS; see audit residuals.

sourcePsf.note: DIMM range is not a measured per-layer PSF. Preserve unknown PSF; binning adds a 1.6 arcsec box response.

observation.note: OIII restored to reddened state using source c(Hbeta). Do not reapply dust reddening; target atmosphere default off. Source observation noise/artifacts remain.

coverage.note: Only listed integrated lines are available. Empty continuum is unknown, not zero; Pa9 alone is not NIR coverage.

normalization.note: Nominal parent-cube scale only for reversible dimensional audit; small maps say FLAM or omit BUNIT. Runtime amplitudes are relative; absolute photon rate forbidden until independently calibrated.
